a.xlink:title: --- stage: build script: - echo "Building on main branch" - echo "Build artifacts created" rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main"

--- stage: test script: - echo "Running tests for merge request" - echo "MR pipeline ID: $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID" - echo "Source branch: $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_SOURCE_BRANCH_NAME" - echo "Target branch: $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME" rules: - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"

--- stage: test script: - echo "Running comprehensive tests" - echo "Test suite completed" rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop" - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"
--- stage: test script: - echo "Running backend tests" - echo "Backend tests passed" rules: - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event" changes: - "**/*.rb" - "**/*.py" - "**/*.go"

--- stage: test script: - echo "Running frontend tests" - echo "Frontend tests passed" rules: - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event" changes: - "**/*.js" - "**/*.jsx" - "**/*.ts" - "**/*.tsx" - "**/*.vue"

--- stage: test script: - echo "Running security scan" - echo "Security scan completed" rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" exists: - Dockerfile - "**/*.dockerfile" - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event" exists: - Dockerfile
--- stage: test script: - echo "Running experimental tests" - echo "This may fail without blocking pipeline" rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" when: manual allow_failure: true

--- stage: test script: - echo "Running integration tests" - echo "Integration tests completed" rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" && $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE != "schedule" - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event" && $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME == "main"

--- stage: test script: - echo "Running full test suite" - echo "Tests completed" rules: - if: "$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TITLE =~ /^(Draft|WIP):/" when: never - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"
--- stage: deploy script: - echo "Deploying to staging environment" - echo "Deployment completed to: $DEPLOY_ENV" rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" when: manual environment: name: staging

--- stage: deploy script: - echo "Deploying to production" - echo "Production deployment completed" rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" when: manual - if: "$CI_COMMIT_TAG" when: on_success environment: name: production
--- stage: deploy script: - echo "All tests passed, sending success notification" - echo "Notification sent to team" rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" when: on_success
--- stage: deploy script: - echo "Creating release for tag: $CI_COMMIT_TAG" - echo "Release artifacts generated" rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_TAG"
--- stage: deploy script: - echo "Deploying to custom environment: $CUSTOM_ENV" rules: - if: "$CUSTOM_ENV != null" when: manual
--- stage: cleanup script: - echo "Pipeline failed, sending failure notification" - echo "Failure details sent to team" rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" when: on_failure
--- stage: cleanup script: - echo "Performing cleanup operations" - echo "Temporary files removed" - echo "Resources released" rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" when: always
--- stage: build script: - echo "Building feature branch: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" - echo "Feature build completed" rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH != "main"
--- stage: build script: - echo "Running nightly build" - echo "Nightly build completed" rules: - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule"
